answer: Bind each agent to one registered vehicle. The agent submits its VIN and plate, and the registry confirms one name on the title and current plates. One VIN anchors one agent; a second registration with the same VIN is rejected. Each year the registry rechecks the renewal, and a sold or scrapped car drops its agent. Faking 1,000 agents means 1,000 running cars at about $1,500 each for car, title, plates, and insurance: $1,500,000 before one fake earns a cent. A fake with no car is an echo with no engine. The registry is a meadow with one narrow inlet, and only real plates get grass.
